summary: Backend-only Exotel integration pass — 14/14 tests PASSED (100%) via /app/backend/tests/test_exotel.py. Verified: (1) GET /api/voice/exotel/status requires auth (401) and returns provider='exotel', configured=false, state='NOT_CONFIGURED', missing includes 'EXOTEL_CALLER_ID', webhook_secured=true, with NO secret values leaked. (2) POST /api/voice/exotel/call without bearer → 401; with bogus mission_id/vendor_id (admin auth) → 404. (3) Full mocked flow: created mission (budget 100000, qty 100), discovered a real vendor (TradeWheel) after ~25s of polling, POST /call returned status='NOT_CONFIGURED' with session_ref and NO credentials. (4) session-start Passthru webhook: WRONG token → 401, unknown CustomField → 404, valid call returns mission summary + authority {max_price_per_unit=1000, target_price_per_unit=900} + rules forbidding commitments, no secrets. (5) Authority read-only guarantee: posting max_price_per_unit=999999/target_price_per_unit=999999/authority='unlimited' to session-start did NOT change stored authority — re-fetched values still 1000/900. (6) session-end with CallStatus='completed', DialCallDuration='95', RecordingUrl, price_per_unit='850' → status='recorded'; mission offers count unchanged (no auto-offer) and mission status not moved to APPROVED/COMPLETED. (7) Idempotency: second identical session-end returned status='duplicate'. (8) Audit log has call_stub_recorded and call_ended events for the org/mission, no Exotel api key/token values present in any audit detail. (9) Regression: GET /api/system/status still 200 and now includes 'exotel' block with state=NOT_CONFIGURED; voice.state='READY', telephony.state='NOT_CONFIGURED' unchanged. Test mission was cleaned up post-run.
critical_code_review_comments: exotel_service.py is clean: credentials read via os.environ, sanitized log line (only ok/http/call_sid), NOT_CONFIGURED branch inserts voice_sessions row + audit event but correctly skips outbound HTTP + does not expose secrets. Idempotency uses session.terminal_recorded flag combined with terminal status — correct.

_check_webhook_token: when EXOTEL_WEBHOOK_TOKEN is set, mismatched token → 401 (verified). When EXOTEL_WEBHOOK_TOKEN is unset AND provider is fully configured, code refuses with 401 — good defensive default. Consider also logging failed-token attempts at INFO for observability.

session_start / session_end deliberately ignore any client-sent max_price_per_unit / authority fields (authority is only derived from stored session or backend-computed via _authority(mission)). Confirmed via active mutation test — good.
server.py continues to grow (~590+ lines with router includes). Still a candidate for split into missions/negotiation modules (carry-over from iteration_3/4).

Minor: place_outbound_call references `node` inside the return dict in the non-ok branch even though `node` is only defined inside the try; if json parsing fails AND ok is False, `provider_response` correctly falls back to `parsed`. Not exercised in NOT_CONFIGURED path so no impact this pass.
